h1: Custom Jersey Blankets for Bulk Orders
metaDescription: Order custom jersey blankets in bulk from Perfect Imprints. Soft, stretchy fabric perfect for branding events and giveaways.
introHtml: Jersey knit blankets offer a soft, stretchy feel that differs from traditional fleece or woven throws. Made from a cotton-polyester blend, they drape well and resist pilling after repeated washes. This material is popular for corporate gift bags, outdoor event giveaways, and employee appreciation programs because it provides a premium touch without adding weight. Decorate with screen printing or embroidery for a lasting brand impression.
heroAltText: Stack of soft custom jersey blankets in assorted colors with company logo embroidery
